thread_summary: A complex number is a place and a move (Thread 1: Cartesian = where z sits, polar = turn then stretch; add in Cartesian, multiply in polar; pick the native address). A move has infinitely many names (Thread 2: arg z is the staircase theta + 2 pi k, Arg z the home step, z the point on the floor; powers any step, roots every step, principal values the home step, branches a continuous choice with a seam). A function is a motion and a derivative is the move seen when you zoom in (Thread 3: strokes on one clock, the morph, the direction circle with centre A and radius |B| that is a point iff differentiable; CR is B = 0). Every view is a shadow of the one 4D graph. Wave 0: foundation and engines with no cross-imports; wave 1: all 21 stations plus the Lab in 11 goals.

notes:
18 goals: 7 wave-0 engines/foundation, 11 wave-1 station goals. No integration goal: the pipeline integrate stage (smoke --dark on every route, interaction scripts, deep links, cross-links) covers the Unifier's i1-integration without a third wave; the lab and staircase interaction scripts live in those goals.
Wave-0 isolation (ARCHITECTURE 1): wave-0 modules never import each other (only parse.js -> complex.js inside one goal); engines use plain {re, im}; widgets inject token-only CSS; so all seven build concurrently. Pairing by thread affinity: home+problems, addresses+arithmetic, distance+sets, curves+linear, staircase+powers, roots+principal-root, branches+graph4d, powermap+reciprocal, mappings+cauchy-riemann, limits+derivative; lab alone. The direction circle is pure numerics in complex.js plus one drawing helper in derivative.js shared with limits.js.
Control ids, readout formats and window.__mv test hooks for every station are in ARCHITECTURE 9; acceptance criteria cite them literally. Unifier risks handled: textbook CR forms always beside the A/B picture; rho for 1/z relative to |z0| with clamping; --t0/--t1 legibility checked in both themes; small parser grammar; home = map + finder, problems = card deck; the 1/z half-turn on the sphere is pinned by a unit test first.
For the orchestrator: the user asked that each iteration push add a "what to do locally" section to HANDOFF.md for the hourly local dispatch. After iteration 1: pull, npm test, node tools/smoke.mjs --dark, open the site, record what looks broken on a real screen in docs/review/local-notes.md; no media work yet.
as_built_note: After iteration-1 integration the readouts typeset π, superscripts and ×10⁻ⁿ (ARCHITECTURE 10.7.2). Acceptance strings quote the as-built readouts; tests/interact/*.mjs hold the exact pins.
